partial, not scored: covers 17 of its cost subset's 66 tasks; a row ranks once the run holds every task with none in error or unfinished

board: Track D closed on 2026-11-16: what the board found is written up in `docs/Track_D_Findings.md`. Still to come: GPT-6 Astra's remaining sets, appended as they finish.

d1-test: Every row on this set ran on the pinned run code (3b7e7fe9; the Runpod rows ad6bf5e3), from before the seeded documents carried the title block's four names and date (designed by, drawn by, checked by, date: 234773ec, 2026-11-12). A vague prompt does not state them, so a drafter had nothing to read them from and left them blank or made them up. The rows stay ranked: the blank fields cost a row 0.3 to 0.95 points on the 19 tasks with a title block, and with each row's shortfall added back the order did not change (checked 2026-11-13, before GPT-6 Astra's row, which leads by 1.1).
d1-test-hard: Every row on this set ran on the pinned run code (3b7e7fe9; the Runpod row ad6bf5e3), from before the seeded documents carried the title block's four names and date (234773ec, 2026-11-12). 80 of the 100 tasks letter a title block and every model left the four fields blank on all of them: 1.3 to 1.55 points a row, which reorders nothing. The rows stay ranked.
hard-pilots: Pass or fail on 112 pilots at one sample each: the leading row's 95% interval is 33.9 to 46.4, a half-width of 6.2 points, over the 5-point target the leading rows of the four D1 sets meet. It is left so; a set of 112 pass-or-fail tasks cannot reach 5 points at k = 1.

rows.e3-hard-pilots-gemma-4-12b-q8-lms-single: eight pilots ended on the provider's 30-minute turn limit and were rerun once (the stall rule); four did so again and stand as fails (p01-redraw-alignment-cflpnp, p01-redraw-alignment-wfl20, p10-typical-fdot9132, p10-typical-wfl05). Four more episodes were rerun after an engine or harness error. The final record is 96 submits and 16 budget stops (8 context, 4 turn limit, 3 clock, 1 faults), with no pass.
rows.e3-d1-test-gpt-6-astra-codex-medium-sing: as of 2026-11-16 this is GPT-6 Astra's only finished set. Its `d1-real` run stopped at 49 of 100 on the ChatGPT account's weekly limit (not published) and resumes when the limit resets on Nov 20, with `d1-test-hard` after it; it has no overall score until all five sets are in.
